technical.reason: No Blender source, geometry, support-contact, runtime, or rebuild tests were performed by this visual critic.

categories.name: Layout and route readability
categories.rationale: The three player-height views and four cutaways show clear negative space, a continuous transfer route and distinct functional clusters. Exact dimensions, prior layout preservation and runtime clearance were not measured.

categories.name: Grounded stylized art and silhouettes
categories.rationale: OCRU portal, framed entry leaves, carriage, transfer cart, recovery berth and service assets have specific layered construction and believable scale. The angular institutional language and purple/navy/blue/orange colour grouping fit the approved spawn references. A few broad cushion and faucet forms remain simple.

categories.name: OCRU hero function and focal clarity
categories.rationale: The red practical gives the OCRU bed clear first priority. Rails, controls, suit connection, insertion/release hardware and articulated supports remain identifiable; restart and decon form a coherent supporting cluster. Pixels establish a convincing function, not working interaction.

categories.name: Materials and anti-plastic quality
categories.rationale: Painted metal, broad steel highlights, rubber-like dark pads, matte fabric, glass, paper and molded dispenser/bottle plastic separate at useful distances. No dominant uniform satin-plastic or photographic-noise read is present. Bedding and some machine faces retain a regular, smooth finish.

categories.name: Dark lighting and atmosphere
categories.rationale: Gameplay views retain legible floor circulation in a dark clinic, with one dominant red bed practical, a separate warm supply pool and restrained directional accents. The decon upper fixture and reserve/cabinet interiors lose secondary discrimination. HIDDEN_BAG inspection fill was excluded.

categories.name: Purposeful dressing and neglected workplace story
categories.rationale: Clinical stock, tools, sealed sharps, repeated denied-release records, corporate continuity poster, patching, small floor marks and the hidden closed bag/note give an established institutional clinic a mix of quiet and overt horror. Neglect is localized; several large faces remain relatively orderly.

cameras.label: 19 | ENTRY / PLAYER HEIGHT
cameras.observation: Continuous floor route and transfer outline remain open. OCRU is the dominant red landmark; restart/decon and recovery are legible at player height.

cameras.label: 20 | REVERSE / PLAYER HEIGHT
cameras.observation: Entry opening is clearly legible with blue framed pressure leaves. Warm workbench and red OCRU stay separated, with visible route negative space.

cameras.label: 21 | RESCUE ROUTE / PLAYER HEIGHT
cameras.observation: The rescue route between OCRU edge, restart bank, decon and recovery reads clear in pixels; labels and cabinet silhouettes remain identifiable in restrained darkness. No clearance dimensions were measured.

cameras.label: 22 | OCRU CARRIAGE / DETAIL
cameras.observation: Bed frame, rails, articulated pedestals, panel layering and under-bed dark folded form are visible. Vinyl and metal responses separate. Cushion surface is somewhat regular and the pillow edge slightly faceted.

cameras.label: 23 | CLINICAL WORK / DETAIL
cameras.observation: Bottle labels/caps, matte gloves, tape rolls, steel scissors/tray and shift log read as distinct functional materials. Repeated denied-release log supplies specific institutional horror.

cameras.label: 01 | FRONT LEFT / CUTAWAY
cameras.observation: Recovery and supplies remain a distinct local pool; OCRU red light is isolated. Open floor dominates between functional clusters.

cameras.label: 02 | FRONT RIGHT / CUTAWAY
cameras.observation: Full footprint clearly shows transfer outline and access to restart/decon; quiet flooring balances the denser working clusters.

cameras.label: 03 | REAR LEFT / CUTAWAY
cameras.observation: Whole footprint and open movement lane are readable. OCRU, recovery, supplies, entry, rear utility zone occupy distinct functional clusters.

cameras.label: 04 | REAR RIGHT / CUTAWAY
cameras.observation: Opposite cutaway confirms uncluttered circulation and strong OCRU mass. Hidden wall/ceiling structure makes some fixtures appear unsupported only in the cutaway.

cameras.label: 05 | ENTRY WALL
cameras.observation: Entry leaves, wall thickness, framing and threshold are legible. Dark outside opening preserves a larger-facility connection.

cameras.label: 06 | OCRU WALL
cameras.observation: OCRU silhouette is authoritative and angular with layered portal, controls, hose, bed rails and pedestals; small overt red-brown floor marks support the horror story.

cameras.label: 07 | RESTART / DECON WALL
cameras.observation: Restart/decon wall remains readable at low illumination; framed racks, console, hose and cabinet are specific institutional equipment.

cameras.label: 08 | RECOVERY / SUPPLIES WALL
cameras.observation: Recovery bed fabric, wall cabinet, handwash and supplies share a coherent spawn-related institutional palette; poster and paperwork form one sparse narrative cluster.

cameras.label: 09 | OCRU REANIMATION UNIT
cameras.observation: Red practical clearly dominates and bed/control functions remain readable. Portal and bed construction avoid a dominant default-primitive read.

cameras.label: 10 | RESTART CONSOLE
cameras.observation: Guarded controls, inset monitors, drawers, toe rail and panel seams produce specific manufactured logic, although broad faces remain simple.

cameras.label: 11 | MEDICAL CARTRIDGE BANK
cameras.observation: Blue folded rack and individual labelled amber-capped cartridges are readable; repetitive forms have a functional reason.

cameras.label: 12 | RESERVE POWER
cameras.observation: Two handled power units and open blue/orange cabinet read as an assembled service asset. Very dark interior weakens immediate material and function discrimination.

cameras.label: 13 | DECONTAMINATION ALCOVE
cameras.observation: Dim alcove retains a readable hose loop, utility panel, used-PPE pedal bin and ribbed drain floor. Upper shower/head fixture and upper ceiling are almost black; this reduces secondary equipment discrimination but does not obscure the entrance or route.

cameras.label: 14 | RECOVERY BERTH
cameras.observation: Broad matte folds, hanging sheet, pillow, folded blue blanket and rail/frame construction establish a clinical recovery berth. The blanket creases are a little straight and panel-like at this close distance.

cameras.label: 15 | TRANSFER CART
cameras.observation: Segmented dark pads, yellow grab handle, scissor-lift frame, casters and brakes form a specific plausible transfer cart. Dark broad specular response differentiates pads and frame without glossy plastic dominance.

cameras.label: 16 | SUPPLY WORKBENCH
cameras.observation: Layered workbench frame, drawers, folded stock boxes and purposeful tray/clinical contents remain readable under a separate warm pool. Restrained wall patching and a sealed sharps bin support an established workplace.

cameras.label: 17 | HANDWASH STATION
cameras.observation: Folded basin rim and metal response, tap, molded blue/ivory soap dispenser and sealed sharps bin are recognizable. Restrained broad wall patches and local mineral tint avoid photographic grime; faucet geometry remains quite simple.

cameras.label: 18 | MEDICAL SUPPLIES CABINET
cameras.observation: Blue cabinet leaves have framed dark glazing, handles, hinge edges and visible carton silhouettes. Glass/paint separate, though contents and wall-side utility switch are hard to discriminate in the dark.

cameras.label: 24 | BAG / INSPECTION FILL
cameras.observation: Closed dark zippered bag with pull, edge seams, carry loops and a tiny yellow note is visible beneath the bed in the disclosed 2 W inspection fill. No exposed body or graphic content is visible. This view is excluded from gameplay-lighting scoring.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: The upper decon fixture and some service/storage interiors are close to black, weakening secondary equipment/material discrimination.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.impact: Functions and routes remain readable, so this is a local readability reservation.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: Some broad cushion faces are very regular; the recovery blanket creases look slightly panel-like and the OCRU pillow edge shows a little faceting.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.impact: Local finish limitation; it does not dominate the room as plastic or generic low-poly.

remaining_nonblocking_defects.defect: Several broad machine/work surfaces remain comparatively orderly, while neglect is concentrated in patches, records and small floor marks.
remaining_nonblocking_defects.impact: The horror story is specific and present, but the neglected/hopeless mood is slightly uneven across secondary surfaces.

qualifications: Layout/route points judge apparent current-camera readability only. Exact room boundaries, geometry preservation against the initial room, dimensions and numerical clearances were not tested.
Visible construction does not establish support gaps, hidden intersections, normals, mesh quality, object counts, collider validity or physical interaction.

The manifest reports complete=true, 24 shots, cold_open=true and source/renderer hashes. This review checked manifest/file completeness and actual PNG dimensions, but did not launch or audit a cold-start process.
HIDDEN_BAG contains a disclosed temporary 2 W inspection fill and contributes only bag/detail/story evidence; it does not establish saved gameplay lighting or authored light counts.
Only the current render set was assessed. No prior cycle was read, compared or used to claim stability, regression status or final production acceptance.
Runtime, Unity material equivalence, gameplay behavior, function bindings, promotion, merge and owner approval remain outside this visual review.
current_only_conclusion: The current pixels meet all six visual minimums and all 24 camera gates, with zero observed critical visual blockers. Overall /100 acceptance, technical readiness and the required cross-cycle stability remain separate gates.
